name: analyze latest workerd dump (kj message extraction)
description: Scans the most recent workerd .dmp for kj source locations (file.c++:line), human-readable error phrases, and Win32/syscall error names. No WinDbg/symbols required.
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $dumps='${DiagDir}\dumps'; $dmp = Get-ChildItem -Path $dumps -Filter 'workerd*.dmp' -ErrorAction Stop | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $dmp) { Write-Error 'no workerd*.dmp found'; exit 2 }; Write-Output ("dump: " + $dmp.FullName + "  (" + [math]::Round($dmp.Length/1MB,1) + ' MB)'); Write-Output ''; $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($dmp.FullName); Write-Output ('loaded ' + $bytes.Length + ' bytes; scanning ASCII strings ...'); $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder; $strings = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; $cur = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder; for ($i=0; $i -lt $bytes.Length; $i++) { $b = $bytes[$i]; if ($b -ge 0x20 -and $b -lt 0x7f) { [void]$cur.Append([char]$b); } else { if ($cur.Length -ge 8) { [void]$strings.Add($cur.ToString()); }; [void]$cur.Clear(); } }; if ($cur.Length -ge 8) { [void]$strings.Add($cur.ToString()); }; Write-Output ('extracted ' + $strings.Count + ' strings (>=8 chars)'); Write-Output ''; $patterns = @{ 'kj/workerd source locations'='\b(workerd|kj|src/workerd|src/kj)/[a-zA-Z0-9_\-/]+\.(c\+\+|h)(:\d+)?\b'; 'kj fail/expect messages'='^(failed:|expected |error |unable |cannot |refused:|disconnected:|overloaded:|unimplemented:|unauthenticated:|EAGAIN|EACCES|EADDR|EBADF|ECONN|EEXIST|ENOENT|EPERM|EPIPE|ETIMEDOUT|EINVAL).{0,200}$'; 'win32/wsa errors'='\b(WSA[A-Z]+|ERROR_[A-Z_]+|STATUS_[A-Z_]+|0x[0-9A-Fa-f]{8})\b'; 'v8 / icu / capnp hints'='\b(V8::Initialize|InitializePlatform|icudt|icuuc|capnp|libcrypto|libssl|node:|v8::|TerminateExecution|FATAL ERROR|CHECK failed)\b' }; foreach ($k in $patterns.Keys) { Write-Output ('=== ' + $k + ' ==='); $hits = $strings | Select-String -Pattern $patterns[$k] -AllMatches | ForEach-Object { $_.Matches.Value } | Sort-Object -Unique; $hits | Select-Object -First 60 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ }; Write-Output '' };  Write-Output '=== top long strings near matches (heuristic root-cause text) ==='; $strings | Where-Object { $_.Length -ge 30 -and $_.Length -le 300 -and ($_ -match 'fail|error|unable|cannot|refused|denied|invalid|missing|not found|address|bind|listen|socket|crypto|init|terminate|abort|capnp|workerd|isolate|v8|icu') } | Sort-Object -Unique | Select-Object -First 80 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ }
